answer: Commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files one claim in the atlas ledger, sealed by a velvet hash, mirror copy open for replay. Each epoch the beacon summons 5% to reveal against the hash; one key, one claim. A mismatch burns the bond; a second claim under one key exposes rented keys. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 credits, plus 70 per failed reveal, against a 40,000 pool, so forgery loses. Honest agents pay 70 once and keep it.
